title: 7 Best Hostinger AI Builder Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Hostinger AI Builder alternatives ranked for anyone tired of the renewal-price jump. Blink, Wix, Squarespace, Base44, Durable — honest pros and cons, real pricing.
